</div></div><div class="sqs-block html-block sqs-block-html" data-block-type="2" data-border-radii="&#123;&quot;topLeft&quot;:&#123;&quot;unit&quot;:&quot;px&quot;,&quot;value&quot;:0.0&#125;,&quot;topRight&quot;:&#123;&quot;unit&quot;:&quot;px&quot;,&quot;value&quot;:0.0&#125;,&quot;bottomLeft&quot;:&#123;&quot;unit&quot;:&quot;px&quot;,&quot;value&quot;:0.0&#125;,&quot;bottomRight&quot;:&#123;&quot;unit&quot;:&quot;px&quot;,&quot;value&quot;:0.0&#125;&#125;" data-sqsp-block="text" id="block-84e449821adf8d3b79b2"><div class="sqs-block-content">
<div class="sqs-html-content" data-sqsp-text-block-content>
  <p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Learn how to kitesurf on one of the most stunning beaches in Kenya. We follow International Kiteboarding Organization (IKO) standards to get you up riding in no time and in the safest way possible!</p><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">We have <strong>Two main</strong> seasons:  </p><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;"><strong>- December and March (Kaskazi): Consistent 13-18 knots blowing cross-onshore (north east)</strong></p><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;"><strong>- May to October (Kuzi): Consistent 17-31 knots blowing cross-onshore (south east)</strong></p><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;"><strong>- November and April brings sporadic winds of  8-13 knots (great for foil sessions)  </strong></p><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">We offer courses for any/all riding levels. If you’re a total beginner, start with a 7h course to see what kiting is all about! If you’ve had a long break and need a recap, take a 3h refresher course. We even offer supervised rentals should you wish to refine your skills before renting with confidence from us.</p><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Already know how to kite? You can rent the newest F-One gear at our centre! Our beach assistants are there to set up your kite, help you launch / land and keep an eye on you while you’re on the water.</p><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Please send us an email/give us a call so we can give you a full breakdown of the courses and offers we have available at the centre to ensure we tailor your experience to your specific needs.</p>
</div>

          <img tabindex="0" role="button" aria-label="Slide 5" data-type="image" data-load="false" elementtiming="system-gallery-thumbnail" data-src="https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/5cda706c7a1fbd52c62a5572/1668066882948-C1S6PK4X4T0QTV78W1I8/G77A7483-2.jpg" data-image="https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/5cda706c7a1fbd52c62a5572/1668066882948-C1S6PK4X4T0QTV78W1I8/G77A7483-2.jpg" data-image-dimensions="2048x1365" data-image-focal-point="0.5,0.5" alt="G77A7483-2.jpg"  src="https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/5cda706c7a1fbd52c62a5572/1668066882948-C1S6PK4X4T0QTV78W1I8/G77A7483-2.jpg" height="0" alt="Slide 5" sizes="0px" style="display:block" srcset="https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/5cda706c7a1fbd52c62a5572/1668066882948-C1S6PK4X4T0QTV78W1I8/G77A7483-2.jpg?format=100w 100w, https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/5cda706c7a1fbd52c62a5572/1668066882948-C1S6PK4X4T0QTV78W1I8/G77A7483-2.jpg?format=300w 300w, https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/5cda706c7a1fbd52c62a5572/1668066882948-C1S6PK4X4T0QTV78W1I8/G77A7483-2.jpg?format=500w 500w, https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/5cda706c7a1fbd52c62a5572/1668066882948-C1S6PK4X4T0QTV78W1I8/G77A7483-2.jpg?format=750w 750w, https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/5cda706c7a1fbd52c62a5572/1668066882948-C1S6PK4X4T0QTV78W1I8/G77A7483-2.jpg?format=1000w 1000w, https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/5cda706c7a1fbd52c62a5572/1668066882948-C1S6PK4X4T0QTV78W1I8/G77A7483-2.jpg?format=1500w 1500w, https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/5cda706c7a1fbd52c62a5572/1668066882948-C1S6PK4X4T0QTV78W1I8/G77A7483-2.jpg?format=2500w 2500w" loading="lazy" decoding="async" data-loader="sqs">
    </div>
</div></div><div class="sqs-block html-block sqs-block-html" data-block-type="2" data-border-radii="&#123;&quot;topLeft&quot;:&#123;&quot;unit&quot;:&quot;px&quot;,&quot;value&quot;:0.0&#125;,&quot;topRight&quot;:&#123;&quot;unit&quot;:&quot;px&quot;,&quot;value&quot;:0.0&#125;,&quot;bottomLeft&quot;:&#123;&quot;unit&quot;:&quot;px&quot;,&quot;value&quot;:0.0&#125;,&quot;bottomRight&quot;:&#123;&quot;unit&quot;:&quot;px&quot;,&quot;value&quot;:0.0&#125;&#125;" data-sqsp-block="text" id="block-yui_3_17_2_1_1668065225259_45342"><div class="sqs-block-content">
<div class="sqs-html-content" data-sqsp-text-block-content>
  <h3 style="white-space:pre-wrap;"><strong>Would you like to turn your kitesurfing passion into a way of living and travel at the same time?</strong> </h3><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">IKO pro training courses allow you to work as an instructor around the world! There are over 250 affiliated kite centres in 60 countries, so you have plenty of destinations to choose from. It’s also great if you simply want to improve your theoretical skills, such as kite technology, wind and weather patterns and aerodynamics. It will also massively improve your riding skills as you will focus a lot on common mistakes and how to solve them.&nbsp;</p><p class="" data-rte-preserve-empty="true" style="white-space:pre-wrap;"></p><h3 style="white-space:pre-wrap;"><strong>Why should you do a kitesurfing instructor course in Kilifi?</strong>&nbsp;</h3><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Kilifi is a real kitesurfing paradise,&nbsp; with consistent wind blowing cross on-shore with an average of 13-18 knots. The beach is sandy and wide, which makes it a great training condition, both for a newby instructor and your students. The water temperature is about 28 degrees, so you can leave your wetsuit at home. &nbsp;</p><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Your examiner will be Xavier Roussos.</p><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Kite gear is provided for the whole course. Please have your harness, 50N buoyancy aid, helmet and water booties (the reef gets exposed at low tide).</p><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">For the course participants, we offer 10% discount for accommodation at Salty’s!</p><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Feel free to contact us if you have any questions!</p><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Dates:</p><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">TO BE ANNOUNCED</p>
</div>
</div></div><div class="sqs-block website-component-block sqs-block-website-component sqs-block-horizontalrule horizontalrule-block" data-block-css="[&quot;https://definitions.sqspcdn.com/website-component-definition/static-assets/website.components.horizontalrule/842be9a2-e72a-4e93-9fc1-0a14edc3d8a9_341/website.components.horizontalrule.styles.css&quot;]" data-block-scripts="[&quot;https://definitions.sqspcdn.com/website-component-definition/static-assets/website.components.horizontalrule/842be9a2-e72a-4e93-9fc1-0a14edc3d8a9_341/website.components.horizontalrule.visitor.js&quot;]" data-block-type="1337" data-definition-name="website.components.horizontalrule" data-sqsp-block="line" data-website-component-id="yui_3_17_2_1_1641976039351_46011" id="block-yui_3_17_2_1_1641976039351_46011"><div class="sqs-block-content">
<div>
  <hr />
    <style class="transform-overrides-vars"></style>
</div>
</div></div><div class="sqs-block html-block sqs-block-html" data-block-type="2" data-border-radii="&#123;&quot;topLeft&quot;:&#123;&quot;unit&quot;:&quot;px&quot;,&quot;value&quot;:0.0&#125;,&quot;topRight&quot;:&#123;&quot;unit&quot;:&quot;px&quot;,&quot;value&quot;:0.0&#125;,&quot;bottomLeft&quot;:&#123;&quot;unit&quot;:&quot;px&quot;,&quot;value&quot;:0.0&#125;,&quot;bottomRight&quot;:&#123;&quot;unit&quot;:&quot;px&quot;,&quot;value&quot;:0.0&#125;&#125;" data-sqsp-block="text" id="block-yui_3_17_2_1_1641976039351_24262"><div class="sqs-block-content">
<div class="sqs-html-content" data-sqsp-text-block-content>
  <h1 style="text-align:center;white-space:pre-wrap;">OTHER ACTIVITIES AROUND TOWN</h1>
</div>
</div></div><div class="row sqs-row"><div class="col sqs-col-4 span-4"><div class="sqs-block html-block sqs-block-html" data-block-type="2" data-border-radii="&#123;&quot;topLeft&quot;:&#123;&quot;unit&quot;:&quot;px&quot;,&quot;value&quot;:0.0&#125;,&quot;topRight&quot;:&#123;&quot;unit&quot;:&quot;px&quot;,&quot;value&quot;:0.0&#125;,&quot;bottomLeft&quot;:&#123;&quot;unit&quot;:&quot;px&quot;,&quot;value&quot;:0.0&#125;,&quot;bottomRight&quot;:&#123;&quot;unit&quot;:&quot;px&quot;,&quot;value&quot;:0.0&#125;&#125;" data-sqsp-block="text" id="block-yui_3_17_2_1_1559209534753_184751"><div class="sqs-block-content">
<div class="sqs-html-content" data-sqsp-text-block-content>
  <h2 style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Downwinders</h2>
</div>
</div></div></div><div class="col sqs-col-8 span-8"><div class="sqs-block html-block sqs-block-html" data-block-type="2" data-border-radii="&#123;&quot;topLeft&quot;:&#123;&quot;unit&quot;:&quot;px&quot;,&quot;value&quot;:0.0&#125;,&quot;topRight&quot;:&#123;&quot;unit&quot;:&quot;px&quot;,&quot;value&quot;:0.0&#125;,&quot;bottomLeft&quot;:&#123;&quot;unit&quot;:&quot;px&quot;,&quot;value&quot;:0.0&#125;,&quot;bottomRight&quot;:&#123;&quot;unit&quot;:&quot;px&quot;,&quot;value&quot;:0.0&#125;&#125;" data-sqsp-block="text" id="block-6f4b4e86175b1a8784ac"><div class="sqs-block-content">
<div class="sqs-html-content" data-sqsp-text-block-content>
  <p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;"><strong>The Kenyan coastline offers a beautiful scenery of marine flora and fauna, and what&nbsp; better way to see it all other than doing a downwinder with one of the Salty’s team!</strong></p><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;"><strong>Enquire with us when you get here!</strong></p><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">&nbsp;</p>
</div>
</div></div><div class="sqs-block website-component-block sqs-block-website-component sqs-block-horizontalrule horizontalrule-block" data-block-css="[&quot;https://definitions.sqspcdn.com/website-component-definition/static-assets/website.components.horizontalrule/842be9a2-e72a-4e93-9fc1-0a14edc3d8a9_341/website.components.horizontalrule.styles.css&quot;]" data-block-scripts="[&quot;https://definitions.sqspcdn.com/website-component-definition/static-assets/website.components.horizontalrule/842be9a2-e72a-4e93-9fc1-0a14edc3d8a9_341/website.components.horizontalrule.visitor.js&quot;]" data-block-type="1337" data-definition-name="website.components.horizontalrule" data-sqsp-block="line" data-website-component-id="yui_3_17_2_1_1570430459393_189250" id="block-yui_3_17_2_1_1570430459393_189250"><div class="sqs-block-content">
<div>
  <hr />
    <style class="transform-overrides-vars"></style>
</div>
</div></div></div></div><div class="row sqs-row"><div class="col sqs-col-4 span-4"><div class="sqs-block html-block sqs-block-html" data-block-type="2" data-border-radii="&#123;&quot;topLeft&quot;:&#123;&quot;unit&quot;:&quot;px&quot;,&quot;value&quot;:0.0&#125;,&quot;topRight&quot;:&#123;&quot;unit&quot;:&quot;px&quot;,&quot;value&quot;:0.0&#125;,&quot;bottomLeft&quot;:&#123;&quot;unit&quot;:&quot;px&quot;,&quot;value&quot;:0.0&#125;,&quot;bottomRight&quot;:&#123;&quot;unit&quot;:&quot;px&quot;,&quot;value&quot;:0.0&#125;&#125;" data-sqsp-block="text" id="block-918cb40223f8a1563e3c"><div class="sqs-block-content">
<div class="sqs-html-content" data-sqsp-text-block-content>
  <h2 style="white-space:pre-wrap;">What Other activities can you do at salty’s kilifi? </h2>
</div>
</div></div></div><div class="col sqs-col-8 span-8"><div class="row sqs-row"><div class="col sqs-col-4 span-4"><div class="sqs-block html-block sqs-block-html" data-block-type="2" data-border-radii="&#123;&quot;topLeft&quot;:&#123;&quot;unit&quot;:&quot;px&quot;,&quot;value&quot;:0.0&#125;,&quot;topRight&quot;:&#123;&quot;unit&quot;:&quot;px&quot;,&quot;value&quot;:0.0&#125;,&quot;bottomLeft&quot;:&#123;&quot;unit&quot;:&quot;px&quot;,&quot;value&quot;:0.0&#125;,&quot;bottomRight&quot;:&#123;&quot;unit&quot;:&quot;px&quot;,&quot;value&quot;:0.0&#125;&#125;" data-sqsp-block="text" id="block-1e588da1b5c84dd6ad41"><div class="sqs-block-content">
<div class="sqs-html-content" data-sqsp-text-block-content>
  <h3 style="white-space:pre-wrap;"><strong>Motorbike riding</strong> </h3><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Rent some motorbikes and take a ride through beautiful Giriama tribe villages, get lost through the creek and watch epic sunsets!</p><h3 style="white-space:pre-wrap;"><strong>Diving</strong></h3><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Kilifi has beautiful  sub-marine life, so please let us know if you would like to go diving. We can organise this!</p><h3 style="white-space:pre-wrap;"><strong>Deep Sea Fishing</strong></h3><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Are you an avid fisherman? Please enquire with us at reception if you would like to find out more about any fishing charters. </p>
</div>
</div></div></div><div class="col sqs-col-4 span-4"><div class="sqs-block html-block sqs-block-html" data-block-type="2" data-border-radii="&#123;&quot;topLeft&quot;:&#123;&quot;unit&quot;:&quot;px&quot;,&quot;value&quot;:0.0&#125;,&quot;topRight&quot;:&#123;&quot;unit&quot;:&quot;px&quot;,&quot;value&quot;:0.0&#125;,&quot;bottomLeft&quot;:&#123;&quot;unit&quot;:&quot;px&quot;,&quot;value&quot;:0.0&#125;,&quot;bottomRight&quot;:&#123;&quot;unit&quot;:&quot;px&quot;,&quot;value&quot;:0.0&#125;&#125;" data-sqsp-block="text" id="block-718efc0434e4da37c1ae"><div class="sqs-block-content">
<div class="sqs-html-content" data-sqsp-text-block-content>
  <h3 style="white-space:pre-wrap;"><strong>Sailing</strong></h3><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Whether it is on a traditional swahili dhow, or on a small lazer boat inside the beautiful Kilifi creek, we can organise sailing trips. Please enquire with us. </p><h3 style="white-space:pre-wrap;"><strong>Safari</strong> </h3><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Only 25 minutes drive away is the beautiful Arabuko Sokoke forest. There you will be able to observe indigenous flora and fauna as well as have the chance to see Savannah Elephants and Buffalo from the sunset platform. Perfect for an afternoon visit!</p><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">If you are feeling more adventurous and really want to immerse yourself with a life changing experience-head to Tsavo East, only a 3 hour drive until this famous national game park. Please inquire for more details!</p>
</div>
</div></div></div></div></div></div><div class="sqs-block website-component-block sqs-block-website-component sqs-block-horizontalrule horizontalrule-block" data-block-css="[&quot;https://definitions.sqspcdn.com/website-component-definition/static-assets/website.components.horizontalrule/842be9a2-e72a-4e93-9fc1-0a14edc3d8a9_341/website.components.horizontalrule.styles.css&quot;]" data-block-scripts="[&quot;https://definitions.sqspcdn.com/website-component-definition/static-assets/website.components.horizontalrule/842be9a2-e72a-4e93-9fc1-0a14edc3d8a9_341/website.components.horizontalrule.visitor.js&quot;]" data-block-type="1337" data-definition-name="website.components.horizontalrule" data-sqsp-block="line" data-website-component-id="b2c05c7d3d25b1ad61b2" id="block-b2c05c7d3d25b1ad61b2"><div class="sqs-block-content">
